parsed.note: Changing WARMUP_RATIO is a standard training hyperparameter tweak; it does not touch the fixed evaluation (EVAL_SHARD 10, EVAL_SPLIT val) and training still uses shards 0-9, so val_bpb remains a genuine measure of model quality.
